text: Overtone: Ger. Oberton ; Fr. harmonique , ton supérieur ; Ital. armonica, tono armonico . The upper partial tones of a COMPOUND TONE (q.v.), i.e. those whose pitch is higher than the pitch of the fundamental. See TIMBRE. Literature : HELMHOLTZ, Sensations of Tone, 25; SANFORD, Course in Exper. Psychol., expts. 87-9. ( E.B.T. )
